It emits a focused pulse of deep violet light toward the tiny ship, a slow beam reaching across the dark like a question offered across centuries.
Bioluminescent patterns ripple across its entire body in a clear, deliberate sequence, each color answering the ship's own signal in kind.
It releases a vast slow cloud of glowing spores that drift outward and englobe the tiny craft in a haze of impossible soft gold.
A single vast eye opens across its flank, iris blooming with cold blue fire, fixing on the speck of the ship with absolute patience.
Arcs of silent energy leap between its body and the ship's hull, tracing the gap between them in bright stitches of living light.
A wave of luminescence passes visibly through its entire body from tail to crown, a shudder of light that reads unmistakably as acknowledgment.
It unfurls a vast translucent structure along its dorsal ridge, membrane catching starlight, spreading wide like a hand opened in greeting.
The space around it warps and shimmers, distant stars bending gently at its edges, as though it is leaning forward to look closer.
It sheds a slow shower of glowing motes that drift toward the ship in a deliberate current, each one pulsing in quiet rhythm.
A low pulse rings outward through the surrounding dust cloud in a perfect visible sphere, the shockwave of something like recognition.
It turns its full body slowly toward the ship, the rotation deliberate and unhurried, a gesture of enormous and unmistakable attention.
From deep within its interior, a light builds and builds until it blazes through translucent flesh like a sun igniting behind paper.
It releases a constellation of smaller drifting entities that spiral outward in formation, surrounding the ship at a respectful and precise distance.
A focused beam of structured light plays across the ship's hull in rapid shifting patterns, reading or writing something against the metal.
Its entire body dims to near-black, then flares back in a single blinding pulse, a breath of light that fills the whole frame.
It vocalizes through some unknown mechanism, and the vibration is visible as rings spreading outward through the thin medium of surrounding gas.
Two vast structures unfurl symmetrically from its sides, wide and thin as solar sails, trembling slightly in some imperceptible stellar wind.
It mirrors the exact color and frequency of the ship's running lights back across its own body, a perfect and deliberate echo.
A stream of coherent light pours from a point between what might be its eyes, forming a narrow bridge directly to the cockpit glass.
Glowing filaments extend slowly from its body toward the ship, stopping just short of contact, hovering there, patient and luminous and waiting.
The dust around both ship and leviathan suddenly aligns into faint magnetic patterns, a visible field connecting them like a drawn diagram.
It contracts its entire massive body inward slowly and then expands, a long deep pulse that moves the ship gently in its wake.
Lights move along its body in a spiral that tightens toward a single point aimed directly at the ship, a slow luminous arrow.
It opens not one eye but dozens, each a different color, each oriented toward the ship, each carrying the same unbearable depth of focus.
A single mote of light detaches from its body and drifts the full distance to the ship, where it hovers against the viewport, pulsing softly.
